terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Terms of Use of ArtAI.win: AI-generated content, fictional models, permitted use and liability.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance
sections.body: By using ArtAI.win (the "Site") you accept these Terms. Creating an account requires accepting them explicitly. If you do not agree, do not use the Site. The Site is intended only for adults aged 18 or over (or the age of majority where you live) for whom viewing adult content is legal.

sections.title: 2. All content is generated by artificial intelligence
sections.body: All images, titles, descriptions and tags on the Site are created by artificial intelligence. They are not photographs of real people and were not taken with a camera. No real person posed for, took part in or was photographed for any of them.

sections.title: 3. All models are fictional
sections.body: Every person depicted on the Site is fictional and does not exist. Any resemblance to real persons, living or dead, is purely coincidental and unintentional. All depicted characters are intended to be adults aged 18 or over. No image depicts, or is intended to depict, a specific real person.

sections.title: 4. AI can make mistakes
sections.body: Artificial intelligence can make mistakes. Images may contain distortions, artifacts or anatomical errors; titles, descriptions and tags are generated automatically and may be inaccurate or irrelevant. The content is provided "as is", for entertainment only, and is not a statement of fact about anyone or anything.

sections.title: 5. Permitted use
sections.body: You may view the content for personal, non-commercial purposes. Without our written permission you may not copy, publish or sell it, download it in bulk (scraping), remove or hide watermarks, use it to train AI models, or present any image as depicting a real person.

sections.title: 6. Prohibited actions
sections.body: You may not use the Site for anything illegal; create deepfakes or otherwise link the content to real people; harass anyone; bypass access restrictions or overload the Site; or create accounts on behalf of others.

sections.title: 7. Account
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping your password secret and for everything done under your account. Use a real email address that you control. We may suspend or delete an account that breaks these Terms.

sections.title: 8. Complaints and removal
sections.body: If you believe an image resembles you or infringes your rights, send a complaint to the Site administration through the form, describing the image and the reason. We will review the request and remove the content if it is justified, even though all models are fictional.

sections.title: 9. Limitation of liability
sections.body: The Site is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any damage resulting from use of the Site or its content, or from the inability to use it.

sections.title: 10. Changes
sections.body: We may update these Terms. The date of the latest version is shown at the top of this page. Continuing to use the Site after an update means you accept the new version.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Privacy Policy of ArtAI.win: what data we collect, why, how long we keep it and your rights.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.body: This policy explains how ArtAI.win ("Site") handles personal data. The data controller is the Site administration. For any privacy question or request, write to us through the contact form.

sections.title: 2. What we collect
sections.body:
Account: email, password (stored only as a one-way hash, we never see it), sign-up date, the date and version of the Terms you accepted, your favorites and collections.
Complaints: the email, link and message you send, plus your IP address, browser (User-Agent) and time.
Server logs: IP address, browser and requested pages.
We do not collect payment data and use no analytics, advertising trackers or third-party scripts.

sections.title: 3. Why we use it
sections.body:
Account data: to provide the service you signed up for (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).
Complaints and server logs: our legitimate interest in handling requests, preventing abuse and keeping the Site working (Art. 6(1)(f)).
Language cookie: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)).
We send only service emails (sign-up confirmation, email change, replies to complaints), never newsletters or ads.

sections.title: 4. Cookies and local storage
sections.body:
age_ok: remembers that you confirmed you are 18+. Necessary, 1 year.
cookies: remembers your answer to the cookie banner. Necessary, 1 year.
locale: remembers your language. Only if you accept cookies, 1 year.
Security cookies of our protection service (for example __cf_bm): tell people from bots. Necessary, up to 30 minutes.
refresh (browser local storage): keeps you signed in. Necessary, removed when you sign out.
You can change your choice at any time:

sections.title: 5. Who receives your data
sections.body: Only service providers that run the Site for us: hosting, protection against attacks and email delivery. They process data on our instructions and only to run the Site. We do not sell your data and do not share it for advertising. We disclose data to authorities only when the law requires it.

sections.title: 6. Transfer outside the EU
sections.body: Our servers may be located outside the EU/EEA, for example in the USA, so data of visitors from the EU and the UK may be processed there. We collect as little data as possible.

sections.title: 7. How long we keep it
sections.body:
Account, favorites and collections: until you delete the account.
Complaints: up to 3 years, then deleted.
Server logs: up to 30 days.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
sections.body:
You may ask us to show, correct, delete or export your data, object to its use, or withdraw consent. You can delete your account yourself on the Account page. For other requests, write through the contact form from the email of your account; we answer within 30 days. You may also complain to the data protection authority of your country.
California residents: we do not sell or share personal information.

sections.title: 9. Age
sections.body: The Site is for adults only (18+). We do not knowingly collect data of minors; if we learn about such an account, we delete it.

sections.title: 10. Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy. The date of the latest version is shown at the top of this page.
